content:
Bailey: Heads up — sync to align marketplace launch with partner crediting and HW co-marketing. Quick check: do we have final partner credit numbers + embargo times? cc @Maya :eyes:
Maya Patel: Draft numbers are in the shared sheet, but not signed yet. Need partner legal OK on the credit amounts and the public copy. deadline request: T-72 for LOA, T-48 for copy.
Liam Chen: For press schedule: we should aim for blog + landing page publish at T-24, embargo lift at T-12 for partners. That gives partners time to queue their comms.
Eva Gomez: For billing/promo side — engineering needs the exact promo code format and TTL. Example API stub for creating promo codes:
```
POST /admin/promos
{
  "partner_id": "partner-xyz",
  "credits": 50000,
  "expires_at": "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Jordan Park: Legal note — any partner logos on the marketplace landing need signed logo usage + benchmarks cleared. Please don't publish performance numbers without SI review. LOA required.
Bailey: Marketing — do we have a landing page scaffold and hero messaging? Also, which partner logos are prioritized above the fold? :calendar:
Maya Patel: Asset drop uploaded: https://drive.redwood/partners/marketplace_assets_v3 — includes logos, co-badging rules, two testimonial quotes. Partners asked for copy signoff by 2026-04-18.
marketing-bot: Checklist: [x] assets uploaded, [ ] final copy signoff, [ ] landing page dev, [ ] email templates, [ ] partner legal LOA. Ping me to auto-create the calendar invites. :white_check_mark:
Liam Chen: Proposed rollout sequence: (1) private partner preview (T-36), (2) landing page soft-live + partner emails (T-24), (3) press embargo lift + blog (T-12), (4) joint webinar + social next week. Keeps risk low.
Eva Gomez: Ops ask — need capacity reservation for marketplace listings and partner workloads. Suggest reserving a small dedicated pool dp-421 for week-of-launch and enabling fallback routing to hosted models. Also need the promo code mapping table before T-12.
Bailey: OK — actions: Maya to secure LOAs (owner: Maya), Marketing to finalize hero + form (owner: Liam), Eng to provision dp-421 and promo API (owner: Eva), Legal (Jordan) to confirm benchmarks/logo terms. Next quick sync tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone needs the calendar, say so and I'll send invites. :thumbsup:
